pairs.name: Brie + Fig Jam
pairs.why: Sweet, dense jam against mild, salty cream. The pairing most people try first, for good reason.
pairs.bite: Smear brie on a cracker, then a half-teaspoon of jam on top so you taste both.

pairs.name: Gorgonzola + Honey
pairs.why: Honey rounds off blue cheese's salty, peppery bite, and the salt makes the honey taste less sugary.
pairs.bite: A small chunk of gorgonzola with a thin drizzle of honey. Less honey than you think.
pairs.drink_note: Sweet wine for a salty blue, the classic match.

pairs.name: Manchego + Membrillo
pairs.why: Spain's nutty sheep's cheese with its own quince paste. Firm and sweet, salty and floral.
pairs.bite: A thin slice of membrillo on a thicker slice of manchego. Same shape, stacked.
pairs.drink_note: A dry Spanish rosado; Rioja also works.

pairs.name: Prosciutto + Melon
pairs.why: Salt makes the melon sweeter; the melon's water makes the ham taste silkier.
pairs.bite: Wrap one slice of prosciutto around a melon wedge. Chill the melon, not the ham.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Smoked Salmon + Cream Cheese
pairs.why: Cool, tangy cream cheese softens smoke and salt. The bagel-shop pair, made for crackers.
pairs.bite: Cream cheese first so the salmon has something to grip; fold the salmon, don't lay it flat.
pairs.drink_note: Bubbles scrub the fat from both.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Hummus + Feta
pairs.why: Smooth, earthy hummus with salty, crumbly feta. The feta does the seasoning for you.
pairs.bite: Crumble feta over the hummus and scoop both onto a chip.
pairs.drink_note: A dry rosé from Provence or Greece.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Aged Gouda + Dark Chocolate
pairs.why: Aged gouda tastes of butterscotch; dark chocolate brings bitter cocoa. Each makes the other taste richer.
pairs.bite: A shard of gouda and a square of chocolate eaten together, not one after the other.
pairs.drink_note: Or a cabernet with soft tannin.

pairs.name: Ricotta + Honey
pairs.why: Mild, milky ricotta is a blank canvas; honey turns it into something you'd serve for dessert.
pairs.bite: Swoosh ricotta in a shallow bowl, drizzle honey, add a pinch of flaky salt.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Goat Cheese + Honey
pairs.why: Honey softens chèvre's tang; the tang keeps honey from tasting cloying.
pairs.bite: Slice the log into coins and drizzle honey just before serving.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Summer Sausage + Colby Jack
pairs.why: Tangy, smoky sausage and a mild, melty-soft cheese. Neither shouts, so both get eaten fast.
pairs.bite: Coins of sausage and cubes of cheese on a toothpick.
pairs.drink_note: A juicy red that handles smoke.

pairs.name: Aged Cheddar + Apple
pairs.why: Crisp, tart apple cuts the fat of a sharp cheddar and resets your palate.
pairs.bite: Thin apple slice, thicker slice of cheddar. Toss the apple in lemon so it doesn't brown.

pairs.name: Comté + Pear
pairs.why: Comté's brown-butter nuttiness and a juicy pear: sweet, savory and fresh.
pairs.bite: A thin slice of pear on a thicker slice of comté.
pairs.drink_note: A Jura white if you can find one.

pairs.name: Parmigiano + Prosciutto
pairs.why: Two products of Parma, both aged for months. Savory crystals meet sweet, silky ham.
pairs.bite: Wrap a chunk of parm in half a slice of prosciutto.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Parmigiano + Balsamic
pairs.why: Two products of Emilia-Romagna: salty crystals and sweet-tart glaze.
pairs.bite: One drop of glaze on a chunk of parm. One drop.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Burrata + Prosciutto
pairs.why: Cool, milky cream against salty, silky ham.
pairs.bite: Tear the burrata open at the table; drape prosciutto beside it, not on top.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Burrata + Peaches
pairs.why: Juicy peach acidity cuts through burrata's cream. Summer's best two-ingredient plate.
pairs.bite: Peach wedges around torn burrata, flaky salt and black pepper.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Chorizo + Manchego
pairs.why: The Spanish tapas pair: smoky paprika pork and nutty sheep's cheese.
pairs.bite: One coin of chorizo on a slice of manchego.

pairs.name: Jamón Serrano + Manchego
pairs.why: Spain's everyday ham with its best-known cheese. Salty, sweet-porky and nutty.
pairs.bite: Fold a ribbon of jamón onto a triangle of manchego.

pairs.name: Idiazábal + Membrillo
pairs.why: The Basque smoked sheep's cheese with quince paste. Smoke and fruit, the way a good barbecue sauce works.
pairs.bite: A thin slice of quince on a slice of Idiazábal.

pairs.name: Stilton + Walnuts
pairs.why: Crunchy, slightly bitter walnuts against rich, crumbly blue.
pairs.bite: Crumble stilton onto a walnut half.
pairs.drink_note: Port and stilton is the British Christmas classic.

pairs.name: Pepperoni + Aged Provolone
pairs.why: Spicy, fatty pepperoni with sharp, salty provolone. Pizza toppings without the pizza.
pairs.bite: Pepperoni slice folded over a piece of provolone.
pairs.drink_note: A juicy red handles the spice.

pairs.name: Pepperoni + Hot Honey
pairs.why: Honey's sweetness tames the pepperoni's salt, while the chili adds a second, brighter heat.
pairs.bite: A thin drizzle of hot honey over pepperoni slices just before serving.

pairs.name: Hard Salami + Provolone
pairs.why: The deli-sandwich classic: garlicky salami and mild, smooth provolone.
pairs.bite: Roll a slice of salami inside a slice of provolone.

pairs.name: Honey Ham + Baby Swiss
pairs.why: Sweet ham and mild, nutty Swiss. The lunchbox pair that works for every age.
pairs.bite: Fold the ham into quarters and tuck it beside a cube of Swiss.

pairs.name: Mascarpone + Berries
pairs.why: Sweet, rich mascarpone needs tart fruit, and berries bring exactly that.
pairs.bite: A spoonful of mascarpone with a few berries pressed into it.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Cheese Curds + Summer Sausage
pairs.why: Squeaky fresh curds and smoky sausage. A Wisconsin tailgate in two bites.
pairs.bite: Sausage coin and a curd on a toothpick.

pairs.name: Brie + Honeycomb
pairs.why: Waxy, chewy honeycomb against soft, buttery brie. The texture is the point.
pairs.bite: A small piece of honeycomb set right on a wedge of brie.

pairs.name: Brie + Pear
pairs.why: Cool, juicy pear against warm, buttery brie. Gentle enough for anyone, and good with every white wine.
pairs.bite: A thin pear slice on a wedge of brie.

pairs.name: Caviar + Blini
pairs.why: A soft, warm blini is the gentle, bready base caviar needs. The salt is the whole show.
pairs.bite: Warm the blini, a small dollop of crème fraîche, a half-spoon of caviar. Use a non-metal spoon.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Labneh + Za'atar
pairs.why: Thick, tangy labneh with herby, nutty za'atar. Breakfast across the Levant.
pairs.bite: Swoosh labneh, pool olive oil, dust heavily with za'atar.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Goat Cheese + Pomegranate
pairs.why: Tart, juicy seeds against creamy, tangy cheese. Jewel-bright on a winter board.
pairs.bite: Press pomegranate seeds into a chèvre log or onto chèvre-topped crostini.

pairs.name: Saucisson Sec + Comté
pairs.why: France's everyday dry sausage with its favorite mountain cheese. Peppery pork, nutty cheese.
pairs.bite: Thick slice of saucisson on a thin slice of comté.

pairs.name: Gruyère + Cooked Ham
pairs.why: Nutty Gruyère and sweet, tender cooked ham. The croque monsieur's filling.
pairs.bite: Fold a slice of ham over a slice of Gruyère.
pairs.drink_note: White Burgundy if you're feeling fancy.

pairs.name: Cream Cheese + Kimchi
pairs.why: Spicy, sour kimchi on cool cream cheese. The fusion bite that converts people.
pairs.bite: Cream cheese on a cracker, a small forkful of drained kimchi on top.

pairs.name: Figs + Prosciutto
pairs.why: Jammy figs and salty ham. Like melon and prosciutto, but for late summer.
pairs.bite: Wrap half a slice of prosciutto around each fig half.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Smoked Trout + Cream Cheese
pairs.why: Flaky smoked trout folded into cream cheese makes a spread that tastes far fancier than it is.
pairs.bite: Mash trout into cream cheese with lemon and dill, or layer them.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Mozzarella + Sun-Dried Tomatoes
pairs.why: Concentrated, tangy tomato gives mild mozzarella the flavor it needs.
pairs.bite: Mozzarella pearl and a sun-dried tomato strip on a pick.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Grapes + Manchego
pairs.why: Crisp, juicy grapes against firm, nutty, salty sheep's cheese.
pairs.bite: A grape and a triangle of manchego, eaten together.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Aged Cheddar + Pepper Jelly
pairs.why: Sweet heat lands perfectly on sharp, salty cheddar.
pairs.bite: Cheddar on a cracker, a small spoon of pepper jelly on top.

pairs.name: Cream Cheese + Pepper Jelly
pairs.why: The Southern party block: pour pepper jelly over cream cheese and set out crackers.
pairs.bite: Unwrap the block, pour the jelly over, set crackers around it.

pairs.name: Nduja + Ricotta
pairs.why: Spreadable, fiery Calabrian pork against cool ricotta. The ricotta lets you taste the nduja without the burn.
pairs.bite: Swirl a teaspoon of nduja into a bowl of ricotta. Don't fully mix it.

pairs.name: Havarti + Smoked Turkey
pairs.why: Buttery havarti and lean, smoky turkey. Gentle enough for kids, good enough for adults.
pairs.bite: Roll turkey around a havarti stick.

pairs.name: Triple-Crème + Fig Jam
pairs.why: Super-rich triple-crème needs a little sweetness, and fig jam has the body to stand up to it.
pairs.bite: A scoop of the cheese, a dot of jam.

pairs.name: Mortadella + Pistachios
pairs.why: Bologna's silky sausage already has pistachios inside. Serve extra on the side.
pairs.bite: Fold mortadella into quarters; scatter pistachios alongside.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Pecorino + Honey
pairs.why: Sharp, salty sheep's cheese with a drizzle of honey. A Roman after-dinner classic.
pairs.bite: Shards of pecorino, honey drizzled just before serving.

pairs.name: Aged Gouda + Membrillo
pairs.why: Quince paste's floral sweetness lifts gouda's caramel notes. A Dutch cheese with a Spanish partner.
pairs.bite: Thin slice of quince on a shard of gouda.

pairs.name: Brie + Cranberry Sauce
pairs.why: Tart cranberry cuts through brie's butterfat. The holiday pairing everyone expects, and it works.
pairs.bite: Brie, a spoonful of cranberry. Use leftover sauce from dinner.

pairs.name: Triple-Crème + Berries
pairs.why: Tart berries are a fresh counterweight to a cheese that is mostly butter.
pairs.bite: A spoon of cheese with two or three berries.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Bresaola + Parmigiano
pairs.why: Lean, beefy bresaola and nutty parm. Shave both thin and add lemon and olive oil.
pairs.bite: Lay bresaola flat, shave parm over it, squeeze of lemon.
pairs.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

pairs.name: Medjool Dates + Gorgonzola
pairs.why: Caramel-sweet dates stuffed with salty blue. Two ingredients, no cooking.
pairs.bite: Split the date, press in a nugget of gorgonzola.

pairs.name: Gouda + Apple
pairs.why: Young gouda's mild, buttery sweetness and a crisp apple. A pair every kid will eat.
pairs.bite: Apple slices and gouda slices, cut the same size.

pairs.name: Gorgonzola + Fig Jam
pairs.why: Sweet jam rounds off blue cheese's sharp, salty edge.
pairs.bite: Gorgonzola on a cracker, fig jam on top.

pairs.name: Camembert + Apple
pairs.why: Normandy's cheese with Normandy's fruit. Tart apple cuts the earthy, mushroomy richness of a ripe wheel.
pairs.bite: A thin slice of tart apple under a wedge of camembert.

pairs.name: Taleggio + Pear
pairs.why: Ripe pear's cool sweetness tames Taleggio's funky rind and brings out its milky, fruity middle.
pairs.bite: A slice of ripe pear with a slice of Taleggio, rind on.

pairs.name: Genoa Salami + Aged Cheddar
pairs.why: Garlicky, fatty salami and sharp, crumbly cheddar. Firm with firm, salt with salt, and both get better.
pairs.bite: Fold a slice of salami over a chunk of cheddar.

pairs.name: Comté + Apple
pairs.why: Comté's brown-butter nuttiness with crisp, tart apple. A fall pairing that also suits kids.
pairs.bite: Thin apple slice on a slice of comté.

trios.name: Brie + Fig Jam + Walnuts
trios.why: Creamy, sweet and crunchy in one bite. The walnut adds the texture brie lacks.
trios.bite: Brie first, jam second, a walnut half pressed on top so it doesn't roll off.
trios.drink_note: Light red, soft tannin, no fight with the jam.

trios.name: Gorgonzola + Honey + Walnuts
trios.why: Salty blue, sweet honey and a bitter-edged walnut. Three tastes that each soften the one before.
trios.bite: Walnut on the bottom as a tiny plate, blue on top, honey last.
trios.drink_note: Port and walnuts share a toasty note.

trios.name: Manchego + Membrillo + Marcona Almonds
trios.why: Marconas add a buttery, salty crunch that makes the quince taste even sweeter.
trios.bite: Cheese, quince, then one marcona pressed into the quince so it sticks.
trios.drink_note: Or a fino sherry for the full tapas-bar effect.

trios.name: Prosciutto + Melon + Mint
trios.why: Mint adds a cool, bright top note to the salt-sweet classic.
trios.bite: Tuck a small mint leaf between the melon and the ham before wrapping.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Smoked Salmon + Cream Cheese + Capers
trios.why: Smoke, cream and brine: the bagel-shop trio.
trios.bite: Two or three capers on top of the salmon, pressed in so they stay.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Hummus + Feta + Kalamatas
trios.why: Kalamatas add a fruity brine that cuts through the creamy hummus.
trios.bite: Hummus, a crumble of feta, half a kalamata on top.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Aged Gouda + Dark Chocolate + Hazelnuts
trios.why: Toasted hazelnuts add crunch and a roasty note that links the cheese and the cocoa.
trios.bite: Break the chocolate small, stack it on the gouda, top with a hazelnut.

trios.name: Aged Gouda + Dark Chocolate + Sea Salt
trios.why: Caramel crystals, bitter cocoa and a pinch of salt: a dessert board in one bite.
trios.bite: Gouda, chocolate, then two or three flakes of salt on the chocolate.

trios.name: Ricotta + Honey + Figs
trios.why: Jammy figs add body and seeds-in-every-bite texture to soft ricotta.
trios.bite: Spoon ricotta onto crostini, half a fig on top, honey last.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Goat Cheese + Honey + Pistachios
trios.why: Tangy, sweet and crunchy, with a green-and-gold look that photographs well.
trios.bite: Roll the chèvre log in chopped pistachios, then drizzle honey.
trios.drink_note: Crisp, grassy whites love goat cheese.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Goat Cheese + Honey + Figs
trios.why: Figs bring a jammy sweetness that sits between the tangy cheese and the honey.
trios.bite: Fig half, a coin of chèvre, a drizzle of honey.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Summer Sausage + Colby Jack + Pepper Jelly
trios.why: Sweet heat from the jelly wakes up the mild cheese and loves the sausage's smoke.
trios.bite: Sausage, cheese, a dab of pepper jelly on top.

trios.name: Aged Cheddar + Apple + Honeycomb
trios.why: Honeycomb's waxy chew and floral sweetness bridge the sharp cheese and the tart apple.
trios.bite: Apple slice, cheddar, a small piece of honeycomb on top.

trios.name: Comté + Pear + Walnuts
trios.why: Nutty cheese, nutty walnut, and pear to keep it fresh.
trios.bite: Pear, comté, walnut half. Toast the walnuts for more flavor.

trios.name: Comté + Pear + Hazelnuts
trios.why: Toasted hazelnuts echo the roasted-nut flavor deep in an aged comté.
trios.bite: Pear, comté, a crushed hazelnut or two.

trios.name: Parmigiano + Prosciutto + Grissini
trios.why: Wrap the breadstick in ham and it becomes the crunchy carrier; the parm sits alongside.
trios.bite: Wind prosciutto around the top half of each breadstick; serve with parm chunks to nibble between.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Parmigiano + Balsamic + Prosciutto
trios.why: Add the third Emilia-Romagna classic: sweet ham with the salty cheese and tangy glaze.
trios.bite: Prosciutto ribbon around a parm chunk, a drop of glaze on top.
trios.drink_note: Lambrusco if you can get it.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Burrata + Prosciutto + Olive Oil
trios.why: A peppery olive oil adds the bitter edge that keeps the cream and ham from tasting flat.
trios.bite: Tear the burrata, pool good oil over it, add a pinch of salt; prosciutto alongside.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Burrata + Peaches + Prosciutto
trios.why: Ham adds salt to the sweet-and-creamy pair, and suddenly it's a whole course.
trios.bite: Wrap half the peach wedges in prosciutto; serve around the burrata.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Manchego + Chorizo + Marcona Almonds
trios.why: A tapas bar in three bites: nutty, smoky and salty-crunchy.
trios.bite: Manchego, chorizo, marcona. Eat in one go.

trios.name: Chorizo + Manchego + Manzanilla Olives
trios.why: Briny green olives cut the paprika fat and reset you for the next bite of cheese.
trios.bite: On a toothpick: olive, chorizo coin, manchego cube.

trios.name: Jamón + Manchego + Membrillo
trios.why: Quince paste adds the sweet note that ham and cheese are missing.
trios.bite: Manchego, quince, jamón draped over the top.

trios.name: Stilton + Walnuts + Honey
trios.why: A drizzle of honey softens the stilton's salt and glues the walnut on.
trios.bite: Walnut, stilton, honey.

trios.name: Pepperoni + Provolone + Pepperoncini
trios.why: A pepperoncini's vinegar cuts through the grease and its mild heat matches the pepperoni.
trios.bite: Skewer a pepperoncini ring, pepperoni and a cube of provolone.

trios.name: Pepperoni + Hot Honey + Mozzarella
trios.why: Cool fresh mozzarella puts out the fire and lets the honey's sweetness come through.
trios.bite: Mozzarella pearl, pepperoni, a drop of hot honey, all on a toothpick.

trios.name: Salami + Provolone + Banana Peppers
trios.why: Tangy banana peppers add crunch and cut the salami's fat. The sub shop on a toothpick.
trios.bite: Roll-up of salami and provolone, a banana pepper ring on top.

trios.name: Honey Ham + Swiss + Spicy Brown Mustard
trios.why: Mustard's heat and vinegar wake up the sweet ham and mild cheese.
trios.bite: Ham, Swiss, a dab of mustard on a cracker.

trios.name: Mascarpone + Berries + Shortbread
trios.why: Buttery shortbread is the spoon. Strawberry shortcake, deconstructed.
trios.bite: Mascarpone on shortbread, berries on top.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Cheese Curds + Summer Sausage + Pickles
trios.why: Dill pickles bring sour crunch to cut the fat.
trios.bite: Toothpick: curd, sausage, a pickle chip.

trios.name: Brie + Honeycomb + Pear
trios.why: Pear adds cool juice and a gentle sweetness.
trios.bite: Pear slice, brie, honeycomb.

trios.name: Brie + Pear + Honey
trios.why: A thread of honey brings out the pear's sweetness and the brie's mushroomy rind.
trios.bite: Pear, brie, a thin drizzle of honey.

trios.name: Caviar + Blini + Smoked Salmon
trios.why: Smoked salmon adds silk and smoke under the pop of caviar. A New Year's Eve bite.
trios.bite: Blini, a curl of salmon, a little caviar on top.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Labneh + Za'atar + Hummus
trios.why: Tangy labneh beside earthy hummus, tied together with za'atar.
trios.bite: Swirl both dips side by side in one bowl, za'atar over the seam.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Goat Cheese + Pomegranate + Pistachios
trios.why: Green pistachios and red seeds make a Christmas-colored bite with crunch.
trios.bite: Roll chèvre in chopped pistachios, then dot with pomegranate seeds.

trios.name: Saucisson + Comté + Cornichons
trios.why: Tiny sour cornichons do what they do on every French plate: cut the fat.
trios.bite: Saucisson, comté, a halved cornichon.

trios.name: Gruyère + Ham + Dijon
trios.why: Dijon's sharp heat wakes up the mild ham and brings out the cheese's nuttiness.
trios.bite: Ham, Gruyère, a dot of Dijon.

trios.name: Cream Cheese + Kimchi + Rice Crackers
trios.why: Light, crisp rice crackers keep the bite airy and add a toasty note.
trios.bite: Rice cracker, cream cheese, kimchi.

trios.name: Figs + Prosciutto + Ricotta
trios.why: Ricotta adds a cool, creamy layer under the sweet fig and salty ham.
trios.bite: Crostini, ricotta, fig, a ribbon of prosciutto.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Smoked Trout + Cream Cheese + Rye Crispbread
trios.why: Rye's sour, earthy crunch is the Nordic way to serve smoked fish.
trios.bite: Crispbread, cream cheese, flakes of trout, black pepper.
trios.drink_note: Or an aquavit for the brave.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Mozzarella + Sun-Dried Tomato + Basil
trios.why: A winter caprese: sun-dried tomatoes stand in for fresh ones, basil does the rest.
trios.bite: Skewer basil leaf, mozzarella pearl, tomato strip. Drizzle with the tomato oil.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Grapes + Manchego + Almonds
trios.why: Almonds add crunch and a toasty note. The simplest three-item board there is.
trios.bite: Cluster of grapes, wedge of cheese, pile of almonds. Done.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Cheddar + Pepper Jelly + Summer Sausage
trios.why: Smoky sausage joins in. Southern hospitality on a cracker.
trios.bite: Cracker, cheddar, sausage coin, jelly.

trios.name: Nduja + Ricotta + Crostini
trios.why: On crisp toast it becomes a two-second appetizer that tastes like a restaurant's.
trios.bite: Crostini, ricotta, a small dab of nduja, a drip of honey if you like.

trios.name: Havarti + Smoked Turkey + Apple
trios.why: Apple adds tart crunch, like the classic turkey-and-apple sandwich.
trios.bite: Apple slice, havarti, folded turkey.

trios.name: Triple-Crème + Fig Jam + Water Crackers
trios.why: A plain, crisp water cracker lets the cheese and jam do all the talking.
trios.bite: Cracker, a generous smear of triple-crème, jam.

trios.name: Feta + Pita Chips + Tzatziki
trios.why: Cool cucumber yogurt, salty feta and a crunchy chip. The Greek table on one scoop.
trios.bite: Tzatziki on the chip, a crumble of feta.
trios.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

trios.name: Cheese Curds + Pretzels + Ranch
trios.why: Squeaky, salty and dippable. A kid-approved trio adults also finish.
trios.bite: Ranch in the middle, curds and pretzels around it.

trios.name: Gouda + Summer Sausage + Spicy Brown Mustard
trios.why: Mild, creamy gouda and tangy sausage with mustard's kick.
trios.bite: Cracker, gouda, sausage, mustard.

trios.name: Gorgonzola + Pear + Walnuts
trios.why: Juicy pear cools the blue, walnuts add crunch and a bitter edge.
trios.bite: Pear slice, gorgonzola, walnut.

trios.name: Camembert + Apple + Walnuts
trios.why: Walnuts add crunch and a bitter edge that makes the cheese taste deeper.
trios.bite: Apple slice, camembert, a walnut half on top.

trios.name: Camembert + Honey + Walnuts
trios.why: Honey rounds off the sulphur notes of a very ripe wheel; walnuts add the crunch it lacks.
trios.bite: Spoon camembert onto a walnut half and drizzle honey. Great with a warm, baked wheel.

trios.name: Taleggio + Pear + Honey
trios.why: A thread of honey softens the washed-rind funk, so even cautious guests try it.
trios.bite: Pear, Taleggio, a little honey.

trios.name: Genoa Salami + Cheddar + Cornichons
trios.why: Tiny sour pickles cut the fat of both, so the next bite tastes as good as the first.
trios.bite: Salami, cheddar, half a cornichon on a toothpick.

trios.name: Genoa Salami + Aged Provolone + Pepperoncini
trios.why: The Italian deli trio: garlicky salami, sharp provolone and a mild, vinegary pepper to cut the fat.
trios.bite: Roll the salami around a provolone stick; pepperoncini on the side.

quartets.name: Gorgonzola + Honey + Walnuts + Pear
quartets.why: Add pear and the blue gets a cool, juicy partner. Salty, sweet, crunchy and fresh in one bite.
quartets.bite: Pear slice as the base, then blue, a walnut, and a thread of honey.
quartets.drink_note: Or a late-harvest Riesling if port feels heavy.

quartets.name: Manchego + Membrillo + Marconas + Jamón
quartets.why: Fold in jamón and it's a full tapas plate on one cracker: nutty, sweet, salty and porky.
quartets.bite: Fold a ribbon of jamón over the manchego and quince stack; marcona on top.

quartets.name: The Bagel Board Four
quartets.why: Smoke, cream, brine and sharp pickled onion. Put it on a bagel chip.
quartets.bite: Cream cheese, salmon, a sliver of pickled onion, then capers.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: The Mezze Four
quartets.why: Creamy, salty, briny and crunchy. A mezze platter in one scoop.
quartets.bite: Use the pita chip as a scoop: hummus, feta, olive.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: Ricotta + Honey + Figs + Pistachios
quartets.why: Chopped pistachios add salt, crunch and color. The prettiest crostini you can make in two minutes.
quartets.bite: Ricotta, fig half, honey, then a pinch of chopped pistachios.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: Goat Cheese + Fig + Honey + Pistachio
quartets.why: Tangy, jammy, sweet and crunchy. The prettiest bite on a fall board.
quartets.bite: Halve the figs, top each with chèvre, honey and chopped pistachios.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: The Game Day Four
quartets.why: A buttery cracker under smoky sausage, mild cheese and sweet-hot jelly. Built to be eaten one-handed.
quartets.bite: Cracker, cheese, sausage coin, jelly. Assemble a tray ahead so nobody has to.

quartets.name: The Orchard Four
quartets.why: Two aged cheeses, crisp apple and smoky almonds. Sharp, caramel, tart and savory.
quartets.bite: Alternate cheddar and gouda on apple slices; scatter smoked almonds alongside.

quartets.name: Burrata + Prosciutto + Basil + Olive Oil
quartets.why: An Italian summer plate: cream, salt, herb and a peppery finish.
quartets.bite: Burrata torn open, oil, torn basil, prosciutto folded around the edge. Serve with bread.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: The Spanish Four
quartets.why: Nutty cheese, smoky pork, sweet quince and salty almonds. Every Spanish tapas flavor on one cracker.
quartets.bite: Manchego, quince, chorizo, marcona, stacked in that order.

quartets.name: Chorizo + Manchego + Olives + Marconas
quartets.why: Every bar snack Spain has to offer on one plate: pork, cheese, brine and buttery almonds.
quartets.bite: Skewer olive, chorizo and cheese; pile marconas alongside for grabbing.

quartets.name: Jamón + Two Spanish Cheeses + Membrillo
quartets.why: Smoky Idiazábal next to nutty manchego, both with quince and jamón. A tasting lesson in one plate.
quartets.bite: Cut both cheeses the same shape so guests can compare; quince and jamón go with both.

quartets.name: The Italian Deli Four
quartets.why: Two salamis, one sharp cheese and a pickled pepper. The antipasto tray, in one skewer.
quartets.bite: Skewer pepperoni, soppressata, provolone and a pepperoncini.

quartets.name: The Hot Honey Pizza Bite
quartets.why: Two salamis, cool mozzarella and hot honey. Everything people love about a hot-honey pizza.
quartets.bite: Fold pepperoni and soppressata around mozzarella pearls; drizzle hot honey over the tray.

quartets.name: Mascarpone + Berries + Shortbread + Lemon Curd
quartets.why: Lemon curd adds a sharp, sunny tartness that keeps the sweet bites from blurring together.
quartets.bite: Shortbread, a swipe of lemon curd, mascarpone, then a berry.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: The Tailgate Four
quartets.why: Curds, two kinds of smoked meat and a pickle. Snack food that holds up outside.
quartets.bite: Put everything in a cup per person so the board survives the parking lot.

quartets.name: Brie + Honeycomb + Pear + Walnuts
quartets.why: Four textures in one bite: creamy, chewy, juicy and crunchy.
quartets.bite: Pear slice base, brie, honeycomb, walnut on top.

quartets.name: Brie + Pear + Honey + Walnuts
quartets.why: Soft, juicy, sweet and crunchy: four textures that make mild brie taste bigger.
quartets.bite: Pear, brie, walnut, honey drizzle.

quartets.name: Caviar + Blini + Salmon + Finger Lime
quartets.why: Finger lime pearls burst with citrus, a bright pop that echoes the caviar.
quartets.bite: Blini, salmon, caviar, then a few finger-lime pearls squeezed over the top.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: The Levantine Four
quartets.why: Two dips, one spice and a chip for scooping. Easy, cheap, and gone in minutes.
quartets.bite: One bowl, two dips, za'atar and oil; chips around the outside.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: Goat Cheese + Pomegranate + Pistachio + Blood Orange
quartets.why: Blood orange adds a juicy, berry-like citrus note. Winter fruit at its best.
quartets.bite: Blood orange wheel, chèvre, pistachios, pomegranate seeds.

quartets.name: The French Ham & Cheese
quartets.why: Nutty Gruyère, sweet ham, sour cornichons and sharp Dijon: a croque-monsieur without the bread.
quartets.bite: Ham, Gruyère, Dijon, a cornichon slice on top.

quartets.name: The Seoul-to-Tokyo Four
quartets.why: Wasabi peas add a sinus-clearing crunch on the side. A board for people who like heat.
quartets.bite: Assemble the kimchi crackers; serve wasabi peas in a bowl beside them.

quartets.name: The Smokehouse Four
quartets.why: Two smoked fish side by side, one flaky and one silky, on rye with cream cheese.
quartets.bite: Half the crispbreads with trout, half with salmon, so guests taste both.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: Feta + Harissa + Hummus + Pita Chips
quartets.why: A swirl of harissa brings chili heat to the cool hummus; feta adds salt.
quartets.bite: Swirl harissa into the hummus, crumble feta on top, chips to scoop.
quartets.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

quartets.name: Taleggio + Pear + Honey + Walnuts
quartets.why: Add walnuts for crunch and a bitter note. A washed-rind cheese anyone will eat.
quartets.bite: Pear slice, Taleggio, walnut, honey drizzle.

plates.name: The Blue Cheese Plate
plates.why: One blue, four partners: honey and figs for sweet, pear for juice, walnuts for crunch. Everything on the plate softens the blue a different way.
plates.bite: Set the blue in the middle and fan pears, figs and walnuts around it; drizzle honey just before serving.

plates.name: The Spanish Plate
plates.why: Two Spanish sheep's cheeses, one smoky and one nutty, with jamón, quince and marconas. Every piece pairs with every other.
plates.bite: Lay both cheeses side by side so guests can compare; jamón ribbons, quince slabs and a pile of marconas between them.
plates.drink_note: Rioja or cava for a crowd.

plates.name: The Bagel Brunch Plate
plates.why: Everything from the bagel shop except the bagel, with crunchy chips standing in. Built for brunch boards.
plates.bite: Set out cream cheese with a spreader, salmon folded in ribbons, little bowls of capers and onions, chips around the edge.
plates.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

plates.name: The Nordic Plate
plates.why: Cured gravlax and smoked salmon with cream cheese and two dark breads. A Scandinavian brunch table.
plates.bite: Fold both fish into rosettes, cream cheese in a bowl, crispbread and pumpernickel stacked on opposite sides.
plates.drink_note: Brut bubbles or a dry Riesling.
plates.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

plates.name: The Mezze Plate
plates.why: Za'atar's thyme, sesame and sumac tie the plate together and add a tart edge.
plates.bite: Swirl the hummus, drizzle with oil, dust with za'atar; feta, olives and chips around it.
plates.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

plates.name: The Gouda Dessert Plate
plates.why: A cheese course and dessert at once: caramel-y gouda, chocolate, toasted nuts, bright candied peel and brittle.
plates.bite: Shard the gouda, break the chocolate and brittle into bites, scatter hazelnuts and peel between them.
plates.drink_note: Tawny port, or a coffee stout.

plates.name: The Goat Cheese Plate
plates.why: Pomegranate seeds add tart pops of juice, so the sweet parts of the plate never take over.
plates.bite: Chèvre in the middle, figs halved around it, then honey, pistachios and pomegranate seeds scattered over everything.

plates.name: The Game Day Plate
plates.why: Add a sharp cheddar beside the mild colby jack so the plate has one gentle cheese and one with bite.
plates.bite: Two cheeses cubed in separate piles, sausage coins fanned, crackers in a stack, pepper jelly in a bowl with a spoon.

plates.name: The Orchard Plate
plates.why: Cheddar with apples and pears, honeycomb and walnuts. A fall plate that only needs a knife for the fruit.
plates.bite: Cheddar in a block with a knife, apple and pear slices fanned in alternating rows, honeycomb on a small dish, walnuts in the gaps.

plates.name: The Italian Summer Plate
plates.why: Ripe peaches join the burrata and ham. Juicy, creamy, salty, with basil and oil pulling it together.
plates.bite: Burrata in the middle, peach wedges and ham ribbons around it, oil and torn basil over everything.
plates.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

plates.name: The Italian Deli Plate
plates.why: Two salumi and a sharp cheese with two kinds of pickles. The vinegar keeps a rich plate feeling light.
plates.bite: Fan both salumi, stack provolone slices, and give the pickles their own bowls.

plates.name: The Dessert Plate
plates.why: A dessert board in miniature: creamy, tart, buttery and chocolate.
plates.bite: Mascarpone and lemon curd in bowls, shortbread stacked, berries piled, chocolate strawberries as the centerpiece.
plates.zero: Sparkling water with lemon or lime

plates.name: The Holiday Brie Plate
plates.why: Brie with pears, honey and two kinds of nuts. The candied pecans make it feel like a holiday.
plates.bite: Brie in the middle (warm it 5 minutes at 350°F if you like), pears fanned, both nuts piled, honey drizzled at the table.

plates.name: The French Picnic Plate
plates.why: Sausage, cheese, cornichons and mustard with a baguette to hold it all. Pack it for a park.
plates.bite: Tear the baguette, smear Dijon, then saucisson, comté and a cornichon on top.
